title: Railway arriving-train CTA
description: The closing call to action as a train pulling in: a long dark carriage over a platform slides in from the right as the section scrolls up and stops with its doorway centred; then the two doors slide apart and a bold heading, a grey line and a glowing magenta-violet button fade in behind them.
notes: carriage and platform are art slots; empty they are plain dark surfaces with hairlines (no drawing)
CSS only: a view() timeline with entry ranges, so the doors finish opening even when the block is last or alone
with reduced motion (or no scroll-timeline support) the doors rest open and the copy shows
